{"sql": "WITH q AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS quarter,
         sum(i.price) AS gmv
  FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1') AS q1_gmv,
  max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') AS q2_gmv,
  round(100.0*(max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q2') - max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1'))/nullif(max(gmv) FILTER (WHERE quarter='Q1'),0), 2) AS change_pct
FROM q;"}

{"sql": "WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat,
         CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2'
              WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' END AS q,
         i.price
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items i USING(order_id)
  JOIN products p USING(product_id)
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
    AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
), agg AS (
  SELECT cat,
         sum(CASE WHEN q='Q1' THEN price END) AS gmv_q1,
         sum(CASE WHEN q='Q2' THEN price END) AS gmv_q2
  FROM base GROUP BY cat
)
SELECT cat AS product_category_name,
       round(gmv_q1,2) AS gmv_q1,
       round(gmv_q2,2) AS gmv_q2,
       round(gmv_q2 - gmv_q1,2) AS gmv_diff
FROM agg
WHERE gmv_q1 IS NOT NULL AND gmv_q2 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gmv_diff DESC;"}
